selection: SHA256(protocol_id + ':' + TriageInput.case_id) ascending within direction; unique perturbation conditions across both strata; exclude all four pilot conditions; no effect ranking
primary_metric: Schema plus reference-validation pass / all fixed input-arm attempts, including provider failures; report full scientific-guard submission rate separately
scientific_retention: Round-trip content projection equality for every successfully compiled adapter proposal; log exact supplied-symbol case normalization separately; never compare independently generated hypotheses as identical
interpretation_limit: Paired engineering interface comparison with different output contracts, not an isolated causal ablation of IDs, scientific innovation, or biological accuracy benchmark; 20 inputs give a descriptive estimate, not proof of population reliability.
